observations: Full CapabilityShader file: direct shader wrapper serialized with IE:ShaderType plus either IE:Shader resource identity or explicit IE:NoShader key; read creates fresh typed wrapper, presence of NoShader suppresses Shader even if both exist. ResourceLocation.parse failures unguarded. This is effect identity on world vehicle/block, not copied runtime render model or reward entitlement.

Actual IEDataAttachments minecart_shader registers same serializer; ShaderBannerBlockEntity conditionally reads shader compound and preserves initialized/prior wrapper when compound absent, writer serializes explicit empty. Parent diskbridge/attachment engine implementation not re-read.

EventHandler onMinecartInteraction actual held IShaderItem sets attached shader on server and sends tracker sync. No item shrink or owner access gate in inspected handler, so it cannot be called paid acquisition receipt. Any cosmetic unlocked/obtained rule belongs elsewhere; pickup branch only first lines read, not claimed full.

MessageMinecartShaderSync on server ignores supplied shader in request and sends current attached state for located minecart; client checks world and minecart then writes renderer cache by runtime entityID. Cache is separate from persisted identity, no authority from client shader value. No distance/rate cap in inspected request. Transport registration/thread validation unreviewed.

ShaderWrapper_Item uses existing item data component ATTACHED_SHADER and removal for null; same shader owner variants/support0, no count per banner/cart/item. Actual renderer sampling/registry fallback not read.
dedup_limit: Not independently compared to all existing cosmetic identity families; no new ledger credit, no production port.
